head_risk_breakpoint.interpretation: New diagnostic adds warnings only, not ticket selections or budget. Day/venue composition differs, so before/after hit and ROI changes do NOT establish that the warning improved prediction accuracy.
head_risk_breakpoint.post_cohort_eligibility: Only immutable pre-cutoff formal/exhibition forecasts frozen after merge with diagnostic v0.2 and read-only flags; otherwise unconfirmed.
head_risk_breakpoint.venue_reporting_note: Per-venue status requires each individual immutable pre-cutoff snapshot with v0.2 evidence. No forecast does not mean a failed venue. Official results are not counted until SHA matched and verified.

motor_exhibition_shadow.warning: Shadow-only; historical frozen change flags may include score-only drift. No formal pick or payout is changed.

same_race_v23_v22_control.warning: Same-race comparator is observational and uncalibrated; do not infer a profit edge from one day.

three_leg_primary_comparison.sample_warning: Uncalibrated bounded attribution within existing exhibition factor, not proven lift. No backfilled controls or new stake. Require >=100 independent forward matched races and venue splits.
